_comment: Known failures, each with the evidence that it is NOT caused by R2a / #251 / R2b. A suite counts as known only when EVERY failing test is listed here and EVERY listed test still fails; a listed suite that passes is reported as a stale expectation and fails the matrix. Proven by running the suite on the `baseline` scenario (no R2a) with identical results on 2026-10-21.
